{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
completed_no_qa = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_no_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print("Number of completed orders after removing QA:", len(completed_no_qa))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA):"," , mean_revenue)"}}
